articles.title: Dan Campbell gets emotional while giving game ball to Lions announcer whose wife died of cancer
articles.summary: Multiple members of the Lions paid tribute to radio announcer Dan Miller on Sunday.
articles.body:
The Detroit Lions took a quarter to get going Sunday, but once they found the end zone for the first time, the team didn't stop. Detroit poured on 45 points in a blowout win over the Arizona Cardinals in Week 5.

But the most impressive part of that victory is what happened after the contest. During his postgame presser, Lions coach Dan Campbell got emotional while handing out a game ball to long-time team announcer Dan Miller, whose wife, Cindy, died of cancer Saturday.

"Let's start with this. This ball goes to Dan Miller and his family. That was hard to hear, what they went through. It's been a tough road for Dan. This is for him. Salt of the Earth, man. Dan is salt of the Earth. I know this has been hard, but now I know Cindy is at peace. We love you, Dan. Appreciate you."

Campbell wasn't the only member of the organization who got emotional when talking about Miller. After Sunday's game, quarterback Jared Goff held back tears when asked about Miller during a postgame interview.

Miller — who has served as the team's radio announcer since 2005 — did not call Sunday's game following Cindy's death. In his stead, Detroit Tigers announcer Jason Benetti filled in. Benetti also made sure to pay tribute to Miller and his family during the broadcast.

Those comments did not go unnoticed by Miller's family. His daughter, Rikki, thanked Campbell and his wife Holly for being " incredible " to the Miller family during Cindy's illness.

articles.title: NFL Monday Night Football preview: Bills and Rams hope to meet again in the Super Bowl
articles.summary: The Bills and Rams are the two Super Bowl favorites heading into Monday night's game.
articles.body:
The start of this season hasn't been perfect for the Buffalo Bills or Los Angeles Rams.

The Bills lost last week at home to the New England Patriots, letting New England back in the AFC East race. Their defense hasn't been great yet and Josh Allen has had some big mistakes the past couple weeks. The Rams have lost two games and almost lost last week at Philadelphia, saving a rough 1-3 start with a rally in the final five minutes. There has been inconsistency on offense and defense, which was rarely the case last season.

And, still, everyone knows the Bills and Rams have the ability to make a Super Bowl.

The oddsmakers believe in both teams. The Rams have the best Super Bowl odds and the Bills are No. 2 as they prepare to meet Monday night at SoFi Stadium. It's one of the must-watch games of the regular season and would be a fun rematch back in SoFi Stadium on Feb. 14 for the NFL championship.

While there are some early-season issues to be worked out for each team, they have also shown why they are among the top clubs in the NFL. Allen was off to a torrid start to the season before getting bit with some turnover issues the past two weeks. He's among the MVP favorites for good reason. The Rams' defense was fantastic in the win over the Eagles in Week 4, holding Philadelphia to 172 yards. Jalen Hurts had just 10 passing yards in the second half. And at some point that defense will get Myles Garrett back, when he has recovered from knee surgery.

The last time these two teams played there were 86 points scored. The Rams won 44-42 in a 2024 regular-season game, despite Allen making history. He had three passing touchdowns and three rushing scores, becoming the first NFL player to accomplish that in one game. He has repeated the feat once since. The Rams did enough to hang on, with Matthew Stafford throwing for 320 yards and two touchdowns, and Puka Nacua catching 12 passes for 162 yards and a score.

Everyone tuning in would be happy with another show like that. A repeat in February wouldn't be too bad, either.

While the Patriots are making it clear they will be a factor in the AFC East race, the Rams are in danger of falling three games back in the NFC West. The 49ers improved to 5-0 and have a win in hand over the Rams. That game in Australia was technically a home game for the Rams, so there is still a return date in San Francisco coming. It's a big game for both teams: The Bills haven't played well in two weeks and a loss would put them back in a tie for first place with the Patriots, while the Rams would like to get some momentum going after a lukewarm 2-2 start to the season. Due to the 49ers' blazing hot start, the Rams need it more. But not by much.

Kincaid has become such a big part of the offense that the head coach had to take the blame for his tight end having just one catch last week.

"I got to be better," Joe Brady said , via Athlon Sports. "There's no reason Dalton Kincaid should have two targets, especially with the flow of the game and how that goes. I got to find a way to get the ball in his hands and do a better job of that."

That usually means a big game is coming. The Rams have been very good against tight ends so far this season, but Kincaid has to be involved. He had 130 and 95 yards in the first two games of the season, then just 45 yards since then. The Bills have some injury issues at receiver, with Joshua Palmer out and D.J. Moore questionable. Kincaid is probably the No. 1 receiving option in the offense (though Moore has looked good when healthy), and Josh Allen is likely to look his way often on Monday night.

A wild Week 5 concludes with a potential Super Bowl preview when the Bills head to Los Angeles to face the Rams. This game opened Los Angeles -2.5 and respected action has pushed it through the key number of 3, all the way out to -3.5. The betting public is split on this game, but the majority of the money is on the Rams. Los Angeles has played only one true home game this season, and it resulted in a blowout 28-6 win over the New York Giants. Josh Allen and the Bills pose a stiffer test, although a defense ranked 26th by DVOA heading into Week 5 is a big concern. Can Buffalo's offense keep up?

Check out more of Ben's work at the Yahoo Sports betting hub .

Fantasy football storylines, by Scott Pianowski

Big things are expected when the Bills and Rams finish Week 5 on Monday night; the total is set at 54.5. Here are three themes to track from a fantasy perspective.

1. What is DJ Moore able to do? Moore was outstanding in the season opener, but he's been limited by his shoulder ever since. A healthy Moore might be the difference between Josh Allen, great player, and Josh Allen, MVP.

2. How do the Rams handle the backfield? For the first two weeks of the season, Kyren Williams and Blake Coram were both heavily involved. In the last two games, Williams has been a true bell cow, upping his receiving work. The first version of Williams is a strong player, but he's looked like a league-winner the past two weeks.

3. Can the Bills unlock Dalton Kincaid? Kincaid looked like a breakout superstar in the first two games; he's been on a milk carton since. It's not a coincidence that Buffalo's better results have come when Kincaid is heavily involved.

articles.title: “It’s something that my mother taught me at a young age”: How Travis Kelce put his mom Donna’s lesson into action with a $1,500 surprise that gave 10 children a day to remember
articles.summary: Travis Kelce gave 10 young sports fans a shopping trip to remember in July 2018.
articles.body: Travis Kelce gave 10 young sports fans a shopping trip to remember in July 2018. The popular Kansas City Chiefs TE handed each child a $150 gift card and spent time helping them pick out new sports gear at Dick’s Sporting Goods in Leawood, Kansas. However, the afternoon offered more than a chance to shop. Kelce also shared the lesson behind his generosity, crediting his mother for teaching him to use his influence to make people happy.The event followed Kelce’s football camp on Saturday, July 14, 2018. He teamed up with Operation Breakthrough and Dick’s Sporting Goods to bring the idea to life. Instead of simply handing out gift cards, Kelce joined the children inside the store and helped make their shopping experience special. Travis Kelce’s $150 gift cards gave 10 kids more than new sports gearKelce spent around an hour walking through the store with the children. He helped them find shoes that fit and reacted positively to the shirts they picked. Some children even added No. 87 Chiefs jerseys to their baskets.The tight end also sat on the floor with some of the children to help them work out how much money they had left or whether they had exceeded their budgets. He stayed with them as they waited in line to pay, making the afternoon a personal experience rather than a quick charitable appearance.During a Kansas City star interview at the 2018 shopping event, Kelce explained why the experience meant so much to him.“It’s something that my mother taught me at a young age that when you have the ability to be an influence and make people happy, to go ahead and do that,” he said.His words offered a glimpse into the personal lesson behind the shopping trip. Kelce wanted the children to enjoy themselves, but he also understood the value of using his position to give back to the community that supported him.Why giving back to Kansas City is personal for Travis KelceKelce also spoke about his connection with Kansas City during the event. The Chiefs star said the city had accepted him despite his sometimes unpredictable behaviour on the field.“I love KC man; they have embraced me for who I was. Even my knucklehead ways on the field,” Kelce said at Dick’s Sporting Goods.He added that he appreciated the community and wanted to return the support he had received. His partnership with Operation Breakthrough and Dick’s Sporting Goods gave him a way to do that while connecting directly with local children.Dick’s Sporting Goods community marketing manager for Kansas City and Nebraska, Shane Cloepfil, also praised Kelce’s work with young athletes. He said that Kelce had become a positive figure in youth sports and that the experience meant a great deal to the children.The July 2018 shopping trip showed a personal side of Kelce beyond his NFL career. articles.title: Packers QB Jordan Love nominated for FedEx Air and Ground Player of the Week for Week 5
articles.summary: Packers quarterback Jordan Love is one of six nominees for the FedEx Air and Ground Players of the Week award for Week 5 of the 2026 NFL season.
articles.body:
Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love is one of six nominees for the FedEx Air and Ground Players of the Week award for Week 5 of the 2026 NFL season.

Love completed 25 of 31 passes for 367 yards and two touchdowns during the Packers' 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears on Sunday. Love ranked second in passing yards and second in passer rating among quarterbacks during Week 5.

Voting runs from Monday to Wednesday. The top two vote getters will win the weekly award.

The other five nominees are Patriots quarterback Drake Maye, Buccaneers running back Bucky Irving, Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs, Steelers running back Jaylen Warren and Jaguars receiver Parker Washington.

Love previously won the award twice during the 2025 season and once in 2024. If Love wins the award again, FedEx would make a $2,000 donation to Feeding America Eastern Wisconsin .

articles.title: A.J. Brown Injury Update, Latest on WR's Timeline to Return to Patriots Ahead of Jets Game
articles.summary: The New England Patriots haven't ruled out a return to practice this week for star wide receiver A.J. Brown.
articles.body:
The New England Patriots haven't ruled out a return to practice this week for star wide receiver A.J. Brown.

Brown is eligible to be activated off injured reserve, and coach Mike Vrabel told reporters Monday there's a "chance" he's back with the team before a Week 6 battle with the New York Jets.

Vrabel might've been intentionally vague in order to keep the Jets and everyone else guessing for as long as possible. Taking him at his word, only saying there's a "chance" Brown practices isn't very encouraging.

Assuming the three-time Pro Bowler continues to be sidelined, the performance of quarterback Drake Maye offers some encouragement.

The 2025 MVP runner-up threw for 269 yards, three touchdowns and an interception in a big 29-26 win over the Buffalo Bills in Week 4. He followed that up by going 26-of-34 for 374 yards and four scores in a 45-17 blowout of the Las Vegas Raiders.

Brown's absence was glaring as Maye threw six interceptions and averaged 7.3 yards per attempt through New England's first three games. He wasn't the same confident quarterback who shredded secondaries down the field a season ago.

Vrabel and offensive coordinator Josh McDaniels may have found a way to get things clicking until Brown is back.

The Jets figure to pose a stiff test, though. They're allowing the fourth-fewest passing yards (175 per game) in the league.

Even if he's not quite at his best immediately, Brown would give New England a different dimension to the aerial attack.

articles.summary: The NFL is reaching the point where quarterback changes may become necessary.Some are inevitable due to injury. Others are internal, with an individual responding to adversity, as the New England Patriots' Drake Maye did in Week 5 against the Las Vegas Raiders. articles.body:
The NFL is reaching the point where quarterback changes may become necessary. Some are inevitable due to injury. Others are internal, with an individual responding to adversity, as the New England Patriots' Drake Maye did in Week 5 against the Las Vegas Raiders. Some are more literal, as seen by the Raiders allowing this year's No. 1 overall pick, Fernando Mendoza, to get his first playing time during a blowout loss. Eventual changes will happen within multiple squads as they are forced look at their options this season and into the offseason.

Each week, Bleacher Report will grade every quarterback performance no matter how their play shakes out throughout the action.

ARI | ATL | BAL | CHI | CIN | CLE | DAL | DEN | DET | GB | HOU | IND | JAX | LAC | LV | MIA | MIN | NE | NO | NYG | NYJ | PHI | PIT | SEA | SF | TB | TEN | WAS

Stat Line : 29 of 47 for 292 yards, three touchdowns and an interception

Arizona Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett faced the NFL's worst pass defense Sunday and posted a season-high of 292 passing yards. Much like everything else Brissett and the Cardinals have done over the past season-plus, those numbers meant absolutely nothing because Arizona lost once again.

Brissett has thrown for 280 yards six times since the start of the 2025 campaign. The Cardinals came up short in each of those contests.

Arizona did establish a 7-0 first-quarter lead against the Detroit Lions. From that point, Detroit scored 31 unanswered points. Brissett was forced to drop back and faced significant pressure. The Lions accumulated five sacks and 12 quarterback hits.

Brissett may not be the problem, but he's clearly not the answer after seeing him start 17 straight games.

"He probably hears the noise," head coach Mike LaFleur told reporters , "but he ignores the noise. He's above the noise."

Atlanta Falcons: Michael Penix Jr. & Tua Tagovailoa

Stat Line : Penix, 19 of 32 for 240 yards and a touchdown; Tagovailoa, two of three for 34 yards and an interception

A loss snapping the Atlanta Falcons' two-game winning streak took a backseat to quarterback Michael Penix Jr. getting injured again. Penix was not able to lead the team into overtime after being hit and suffering a possible rib injury.

"I got hit pretty good and was just trying to get back out there," Penix told reporters . "I did take some throws on the sideline just to see how I felt, and I did not feel like I was going to be able to give our team what we needed to help us win that football game because of the pain that I was feeling. I feel like if we had the ball first in overtime, I probably would have been out there. But as we were sitting, what I was going through just started getting worse and worse. I was getting cold."

Any injury that Penix suffers is significant considering his expansive history. Plus, any potential time missed will once again create upheaval within the Falcons' offense.

While it may be unfair, Tua Tagovailoa was thrust into the lineup and failed to deliver. His interception ended overtime and handed the Ravens a victory.

Stat Line : 24 of 32 for 201 yards and two touchdowns; six carries for 20 yards and score

A backup quarterback exists to keep a team afloat whenever the starter goes down for whatever reason. The goal is even more difficult to accomplish when a squad's QB1 is a two-time league MVP. Tyler Huntley has been up for the task, though.

Huntley was particularly cold-blooded down the stretch and overtime against the Atlanta Falcons. In fact, he became the only quarterback in NFL history to complete 10 straight passes, throw a passing touchdown and run for another in the final two minutes of a game plus overtime, according to OptaSTATS .

"'Snoop' is just like one of the coolest dudes," head coach Jesse Minter told reporters . "He doesn't really get rattled. He's just always the same, and he keeps such a good demeanor about him, keeps his composure. He said, 'Hey man, all we're going to do is try and go 1-0 this week.' That's what he told me right before the game. And he just did his job, and he did it at a high level. He played really well, played with more and more confidence as the game went on and as the moments got bigger."

Chicago Bears: Tyson Bagent & Case Keenum

Stat Line : Bagent, 12 of 21 for 87 yards and two interceptions; Keenum, 11 of 19 for 108 yards, and interception and a fumble

The Chicago Bears' performance against the Green Bay Packers Sunday can be summed up rather easily: Head coach pulled Tyson Bagent in favor of Case Keenum, and the two quarterbacks combined for four turnovers.

"We felt like we just wanted a little spark there," Johnson told reporters . "Tyson just could never feel like he got in a rhythm here today, and so we'll look at why that was the case. The second interception happened, and we just felt like let's give Case a chance out there and see if we get different results." Keenum then Bagent performed well during the previous two games. But they're backup options for a reason. After Caleb Williams became a limited participant in practice last week, he may be ready to start in Week 6 against the Atlanta Falcons.

Stat Line : 23 of 32 for 190 yards and four touchdowns

Joe Burrow played a relatively clean game against the Miami Dolphins, but the quarterback wasn't thrilled with the Cincinnati Bengals' overall effort.

"We got to be smarter," Burrow told reporters . "Two fumbles in the red zone. A couple personal fouls that hurt us, hurt our field position, gave them points on the board. Yeah, we got to be smarter…. We had some dumb mistakes, and we got to get those fixed if we want to be a great team." To Burrow's point, the Dolphins remained closer than they should have been. Cincinnati mostly controlled the contest, but Miami kept making pushes. Still, The Bengals took care of business. Burrow is simply being a good leader by not allowing his squad to be content.

Stat Line : 15 of 33 for 155 yards, a touchdown and a fumble lost; six carries for 40 yards

Deshaun Watson didn't keep his streak of playing well going against the New York Jets. At the same time, the Cleveland Browns offense didn't play well around its quarterback.

The Jets' defensive front feasted with eight sacks and 13 quarterback hits.

"Let's just say this, eight sacks is a season-high," head coach Todd Monken told reporters . "I hope like hell the rest of the time I'm here, we don't have a game we have eight sacks." Cleveland's wide receivers also had key drops. Without Watson added to the equation, the Browns' ball-carriers averaged 3.3 yards per carry. The wet and wild weather certainly didn't help matters. Monken's offense failed at every level. Watson must play better, but blame can be spread to every position group.

Score : 24-16 loss vs. Tampa Bay Buccaneers

Stat Line : 24 of 42 for 316 yards, a touchdown and two interceptions

The Dallas Cowboys offense had been sailing along until Thursday Night Football , where Dak Prescott and Co. turned the football over and proved to be ineffective on key downs.

Prescott threw a couple of interceptions. Granted, both hit his receivers where they could have been caught. Though the ball placement could have been a tad better. Furthermore, Dallas' offense finished a combined four for 11 on third and fourth downs.

Of course, the Cowboys' defense continues to underperform, which makes the offense's margin for error much smaller. Mistakes or missed opportunities turn into glaring problems, because the other side of the ball isn't picking up the offense. Prescott and his unit need to operate at a high level at all times, or Dallas almost certainly won't win, hence the team's 2-3 record.

"We believe in what we're doing," head coach Brain Schottenheimer told reporters . "We believe we have good players and good coaches. We believe the solution is in this room, and we're going to get back to work."

Score : 23-17 win vs. Los Angeles Chargers

Stat Line : 16 of 27 for 123 yards, a touchdown and fumble lost

Sean Payton took over offensive play-calling duties this week. The Denver Broncos didn't look dramatically different.

Payton placed a greater emphasis on the run game, thought, which helped to a degree. JK Dobbins' 18 for 68 yards were both season-highs. The next step is to ensure Bo Nix is comfortable within the scheme and delivering through all four quarters. He's yet to play at the same level he did a season ago.

"I think obviously there's a lot been said about his feet," Payton told reporters . "I think he's settling that down. I think it's important from a protection standpoint that early in games, we provide that clean pocket so that clock doesn't get juiced up a little bit. But I think when we needed it down the stretch, there were some plays he had."

Stat Line : 19 of 30 for 271 yards and three touchdowns

If the 3-2 Detroit Lions stay above .500 as a team, Jared Goff should get serious MVP consideration. Goff is being asked to orchestrate a top-notch offense, while offsetting a subpar defense.

Coming out of Sunday's slate, Goff led the NFL in passing yardage. He's yet to throw an interception through five games. Furthermore, he ranks among the top-three quarterbacks in completions (36), yards (780) and touchdowns (7) on passes over 10 air yards, according to NFL Next Gen Stats .

"Goff is just Goff," head coach Dan Campbell told reporters . "He's as good as they come. I've been so impressed by the way he's played these five games. I thought he's gotten better every year. Now here we are five games in and he's even better than last year. He's the real deal." Goff's game may not be as flashy as a Josh Allen or even Matthew Stafford, but his importance to the Lions can't be overstated.

Stat Line : 25 of 31 for 367 yards and two touchdowns

The Green Bay Packers and Jordan Love rediscovered their mojo Sunday against the Chicago Bears.

The team just didn't look the same during its 2-2 start. Matt LaFleur has always been able to get the most out of his squad, but the same couldn't be said through the first quarter of the 2026 campaign.

Green Bay's Week 5 effort was completely different.

The Packers dominated their hated rival and Love shredded Chicago defense. In total, Love threw for 367 yards. More importantly, he didn't commit a turnover. Instead, his five completions of 30 or more air yards tied for the most by a player in a single game since ESPN began tracking the statistic 20 years ago, per ESPN Insights .

"We have weapons all throughout, as you can see," running back MarShawn Lloyd told reporters . "Our receivers are insane, our quarterback is insane and our running backs are insane."

Stat Line : 26 of 34 for 261 yards, passing touchdown, rushing score and an interception

The Houston Texans finally won for the first time this season. Granted, they did so against the floundering Tennessee Titans. But a win is a win in the NFL. Despite the team's current situation, CJ Stroud continues to provide quality quarterback play.

"C.J. did an outstanding job making play after play when we needed it," head coach Demeco Ryans told reporters . "He was dealing. He was throwing the ball to everyone who was open. Making really great decisions with the football…he's been leading our offense very well."

Stroud completed 76.5 percent of his passes Sunday. He spread the ball between seven different receivers. More help is coming after the Texans traded for Stroud's collegiate teammate, Marvin Harrison Jr.

"Dynamic playmaker, somebody who runs great routes," Stroud said of Harrison. "Can catch really any ball. … I loved him in college. He's probably the hardest worker I've ever been around in my life."

Score : 34-22 loss vs. Pittsburgh Steelers

Daniel Jones didn't turn the ball over for the first time this season. However, the Indianapolis Colts struggled in the red zone and the quarterback failed to threaten the Pittsburgh Steelers' defense vertically, missing multiple throws down the field.

With the Steelers slowing down Jonathan Taylor, Jones had to take on more responsibility in the passing game. He did well against pressure and identified soft spots in zone coverage. But the Colts' signal-caller also failed to make Pittsburgh's defense pay when opportunities arose.

Indianapolis converted only one of three red-zone trips into touchdowns. Jones completed one of eight pass attempts at or inside the Pittsburgh's 25-yard line.

"Obviously, that was a big factor in the game, not scoring touchdowns when we got down there and settling for field goals," Jones told reporters . "We can't afford to do that. We have been good in the red zone. That was a strength of ours. We have to go back and see where we fell short, where the opportunities were and how to improve."

Score : 19-17 win vs. Philadelphia Eagles

Stat Line : 24 of 39 for 331 yards, two touchdowns and an interception; three carries for 25 yards

The Jacksonville Jaguars went from being one of the cleanest operations through three weeks of play to one of the league's worst. Officials penalized Jacksonville 13 times for the second straight game, and quarterback Trevor Lawrence grew visibly frustrated.

"I think he was frustrated," head coach Liam Coen admitted , "but I never felt he wavered. I never felt he got nerfed up."

Despite the sloppy play, Lawrence and Co. found a way to win once again. Jacksonville has now won three straight games. The quarterback threw for a season-high 331 yards in London. Though Lawrence can do a better job understanding situations and how to react when pressured.

Las Vegas Raiders: Kirk Cousins & Fernando Mendoza

Score : 45-17 loss vs. New England Patriots

Stat Line : Cousins, 19 of 28 for 243 yards and a touchdown; Mendoza, six of eight for 48 yards

This year's No. 1 overall draft pick, Fernando Mendoza, finally saw the field for the first time in his NFL career, albeit in a blowout loss.

After a 3-0 start, the Raiders have lost their last two games, which opens the door for Mendoza to eventually take over the offense. Kirk Cousins has performed well enough to warrant continued playing time and Sunday's outcome was due more to a lack of a running game and consistent pressure from the New England Patriots. Besides, the next stretch of games against the Buffalo Bills, Los Angeles Rams, New York Jets, San Francisco 49ers, Seattle Seahawks, Denver Broncos and Cleveland Browns isn't ideal for an rookie to enter the lineup considering the caliber of those defenses.

The rookie signal-caller's first start should be saved for the team's first game back from a Week 13 bye. But his initial performance was promising during his lone drive at the helm.

"It wasn't a great experience because of the overall outcome," Mendoza told reporters . "I was called upon, and I really appreciate all my teammates, especially some of the starters, going out there and still having a fight to win and a fighting effort."

Stat Line : 14 for 24, 121 yards, one touchdown, an interception and a fumble lost

Justin Herbert's downturn between last season and this year needs to be studied, because he went from one of the game's best to counted among its worst.

Herbert has been particularly awful when his team needs him the most. As RotoWire's Ian Hartitz noted , Herbert has four interceptions and no touchdowns, with a 38.2 quarterback rating, during fourth-quarter play this season.

Sunday's performance was no different. During the final frame, Herbert completed three for eight pass attempts, threw an interception and fumbled twice (one lost). He's now committed at least one turnover in five straight games.

"Yep, I just can't turn the ball over," Herbert told reporters . "We can't expect to win games when you turn the ball over. Gotta do a better job there."

Score : 31-24 loss vs. Cincinnati Bengals

Stat Line : 15 of 27 for 137 yards, a touchdown and two interceptions; eight carries for 74 yards and a score

The Miami Dolphins are off to an 0-5 start and there's not much quarterback Malik Willis can do about it.

Maybe the organization is already drooling at the possibility of selecting Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith—a legitimate generational talent—with next year's No. 1 overall pick. As of now, the team's passing game is the league's worst and the offense, as a whole, ranks dead last in offensive success rate for any squad over the last five seasons, according to The Ringer's Sheil Kapadia .

"We've just got to go back to the drawing board," Willis told reporters , "watch these last few games, compare it to practice, understand what we're good at, what we're not good at, understand what guys are comfortable with and what they're not comfortable with, and then just try to go and execute the next opportunity we can get."

Score : 23-13 win vs. New Orleans Saints

Stat Line : 24 of 30 for 229 yards and touchdown; 10 carries for 51 yards

The Minnesota Vikings defense is the driving force behind the team's 5-0 start. However, the team can become really dangerous if Kyler Murray continues to play efficient football, adds a dynamic element thanks to his mobility and finds Justin Jefferson on a regular basis.

Murray understands the assignment when it comes to serving as the Vikings' starting quarterback: Get the ball to Jefferson. This growing rapport was punctuated by a touchdown connection in the back of the end zone with three New Orleans Saints defenders in the vicinity.

"I didn't necessarily see that two-by-two box in the back corner of the end zone that Kyler put that ball into," coach Kevin O'Connell told reporters . "But I will say this. His trust is something. And it is Justin Jefferson."

Murray completed his first 12 passes during Sunday's contest and finished the contest with an 80 completion percentage.

Stat Line : 26 of 34 for 374 yards and four touchdowns; seven carries for 25 yards and a score

A five-touchdown effort with no turnovers is an impressive outing by Drake Maye unto itself. However, the resiliency the New England Patriots' quarterback showed after a painstakingly slow start to the season is astounding.

Initially, Maye didn't look anything like the player who finished second in MVP voting last season. He was particularly reckless with the football making poor decisions and throws through the first three weeks of play. Maye improved in Week 4 in a win over the Buffalo Bills, though his effort wasn't entirely clean. Sunday's outing was simply spectacular, especially considering New England had two injured starters along the offensive line and wide receivers AJ Brown and Mack Hollins are on injured reserve.

"That's our leader. I feel like for offense and defense," wide receiver DeMario Douglas told reporters . "How he carries himself, it means a lot. I feel like how he carries himself is by example. I feel like for us, we need to carry ourselves like that too. Ups and downs, you still gotta stay straight, man. I love how Drake carries himself. It's a blessing. From those past games, anybody could've been down on themselves. Not him. He came to work."

Score : 23-13 loss vs. Minnesota Vikings

Stat Line : 16 of 25 for 96 yards and two interceptions

Tyler Shough and the New Orleans Saints had no answers for the game's best defense. The Minnesota Vikings defense confused, pressured and shut down an opponent that previously featured a top-10 offense.

Shough shouldn't take the brunt of the blame, because the Saints lack a balanced approach. Since Travis Etienne Jr. was placed on injured reserve, New Orleans has been incapable of producing anything through its ground game. Still, Shough hand Co. continued to move the ball in previous weeks. Minnesota simply overwhelmed them.

The second-year quarterback is also dealing with an issue on his non-throwing hand. Despite everything, including three-straight home losses, the Saints aren't looking to make a change.

"He's the guy that's gonna help us get through this adversity that we've faced the last few weeks," head coach Kellen Moore said of Shough .

Score : 27-27 tie vs. Washington Commanders

Stat Line : 33 of 54 for 326 yards and three touchdowns

Everyone understands that Jameis Winston can sling the ball all over the yard. Everyone also understands he could implode at any moment and make a gut-wrenching mistake.

Instead of eating a second-quarter sack, Winston tried to make something happen against the Washington Commanders and fumbled the ball. From that point forward, he led the New York Giants on seven drives that should have ended in points (not including a kneel-down at end of regulation). However, two missed field goals and a Cam Skattebo fumble prevented that from happening.

"It's just a whole bunch of stuff that people want to talk about as bad, but like, bro, the good outweighs the bad," running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. told The Trentonian 's Greg Johnson about Winston. "It overwhelms the bad. So, you have to continue just to keep talking Jameis up, man. Keep talking Jameis up because like, people want to bench him, people want to talk bad about him. But like, at the end of the day, man, that boy is a hooper. He goes out there and plays ball."

Stat Line : 17 of 30 for 182 yard, a touchdown and a fumble lost

A year ago, Geno Smith was a turnover machine. This year, he's the veteran presence the New York Jets desperately needed at the quarterback position.

Even in a rain-soaked game, he only coughed the ball up once, while his counterpart, Deshaun Watson, fumbled three times. Sometimes, the position is simply about making fewer mistakes than the guy on the other sideline.

To be fair, the Jets are 2-3 and still have to contend with the Buffalo Bills and New England Patriots in the AFC East. However, Smith and Co. are only one victory away from equaling last year's effort. The team's remains a work-in-progress, but the Jets are competitive. Smith is a big reason why.

"There's no one I'd rather have than this guy," Jets offensive coordinator Frank Reich told reporters last week. "I'm absolutely loving working with him. His focus and his drive to be better and to be perfect on every play is second to none."

Score : 19-17 loss vs. Jacksonville Jaguars

Stat Line : 21 of 40 for 220 yards and a touchdown

Results speak louder than anything the Philadelphia Eagles have said over the last year. Those on the team continually say how things are going to get fixed, but nothing manifests. Instead, the offense continues to stagnate.

During Sunday's meeting with the Jacksonville Jaguars, Philadelphia produced five more three-and-outs. The Eagles have done so at a higher rate than any other offense since the start of the 2025 campaign.

To be fair, Jalen Hurts played a contest with a first-time starter at center and left guard. Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown weren't in the lineup due to injuries. Despite everything, Philadelphia was in a position to win if not for poor special teams decision late in the contest.

Even so, this type of performance isn't unusual at this point.

"It's not the standard and it's inexcusable," Hurts told reporters . "We've got a lot of opportunity to grow. ... I can't give any promises or anything. Honestly, my words don't mean anything. It's about what we go out there and do."

Score : 34-22 win vs. Indianapolis Colts

Stat Line : 22 of 31 for 235 yards and three touchdowns

The Pittsburgh Steelers coaching staff is allowing Aaron Rodgers to do exactly what he should at this point of his career.

The team can lean on the league's oldest player to place the offense in the right position and use his experience to manipulate defenses. Meanwhile, the system is built around getting the ball out quickly and ensuring Rodgers isn't hung out to dry against pressure packages. Opposing defenses are trying to lock up in man-coverage, create pressure and force Rodgers into mistakes. It's not happening.

Instead, Rodgers has thrown three touchdowns in three straight games, which is the first time he's done so since his 2021 MVP campaign, according to NFL Researcher . But let's also keep in mind Rodgers' three latest touchdowns were A) a dump-off to Jaylen Warren to avoid pressure and the running back took it 80 yards to the end zone, B) a quick one-yard option route to an open Pat Freiermuth and C) a four-yard in-breaker over the middle of the field where Colts defenders blew an assignment. Even so, the quarterback needed to execute and Rodgers did.

Stat Line : 19 of 29 for 189 yards, two touchdowns and an interception

Brock Purdy wasn't nearly as efficient as he had been through the first four weeks of play. At the same time, the Seattle Seahawks defense can be difficult to handle and the San Francisco 49ers still emerged victorious. Plus, Purdy delivered during the fourth quarter by leading two scoring drives.

Purdy completed all nine of his passes during San Francisco's final two offensive possessions (not including kneel-downs to end the game).

"That's one of the best defenses in the league," head coach Kyle Shanahan told reporters . "There were some ups and downs, by no means was everything perfect. But I thought he was really good in the fourth quarter." The potential MVP frontrunner currently leads the NFL with 13 touchdown passes and an 84.7 QBR.

Score : 32-29 loss vs. San Francisco 49ers

Stat Line : 18 of 29 for 195 yards, a touchdown and two interceptions

The bad ultimately outweighed the good from San Darnold's latest performance. He led three scoring drives in the second half, which allowed the Seattle Seahawks to tie the San Francisco 49ers with under seven minutes to play. Previously, Darnold threw two interceptions. The first led to the Niners' first touchdown drive.

"There are a couple decisions I'd like back," Darnold told reporters . "Just putting the ball in a better place on the second one I threw. ... The other one was just a poor decision. I gotta continues to trust myself, trust my feet and trust what I'm seeing." During Seattle's final possession, Darnold completed two of five pass attempts, and the Seahawks turned the ball over on downs. San Francisco is arguably the league's best team right now. The type of mistakes Darnold made is the difference between first- and second-place team in the NFC West.

Stat Line : 19 of 25 for 189 yards and a touchdown; seven carries for 23 yards

The Tampa Bay Buccaneers were staring at an 0-5 start with an undrafted rookie quarterback making his first NFL road start. Instead of being overwhelmed, Jalon Daniels came to play and did so at a high level.

"He learned so much from his first start," head coach Todd Bowles told reporters . "Coming into this game, he was determined to play better. He played within himself. He played smart. He was decisive with his throws. He knew when to run. He did a good job getting in and out of the huddle so I can't say enough about him. He did a great job." Baker Mayfield's status remains questionable as he recovers from a fractured thumb on his throwing hand. Daniels' athleticism, playmaking ability and rapid improvement showed why he earned his spot as the Bucs' QB2 and shouldn't be a hindrance if required to start another game or two.

Stat Line : 23 of 36 for 179 yards and an interception

The Tennessee Titans have already reached the point where last year's No. 1 overall pick, Cam Ward, required a vote of confidence from his head coach and declaration that he'll be QB1 for the rest of this season.

"Cam's our starting quarterback," Robert Saleh told reporters . "We're gonna give him every opportunity to be successful this year." Ward has thrown for 200 or more yards once once this season. With Sunday's effort, he has now completed less than 65 percent of his passes and thrown an interception in three straight contests. But his confidence hasn't wavered despite questions about whether he should continue to start.

"I love the criticism," Ward said . "I love everything that comes with the quarterback territory. At the end of the day, it's the best position in the world. Stuff goes the right way, you take all the credit. Stuff goes the wrong way, you take all the blame. I know I'm capable at this position. I have the right guys around me to uplift me and myself uplift them. We'll eventually put it together."

Stat Line : 17 of 25 for 199 yards; nine carries for 103 yards and two touchdowns

Situational awareness is a critical component to playing the quarterback position.

Washington Commanders head coach Dan Quinn wouldn't place any blame on Jayden Daniels after the team mishandled the final 55 seconds of overtime, which resulted in a tie instead of his team kicking a potential game-winning field goal. At the same time, the quarterback is the leader on the field. The position must have more awareness than Daniels showed after avoiding pressure and sliding instead of taking a knee or throwing the ball away to stop the clock.

"We've gotta relay that as an offense," Daniels said when asked about the mishandled final drive. "It starts with everyone—top down. Ultimately it's on me." Despite the mishap, the Commanders wouldn't have been competitive without Daniels. The quarterback produced a game-high 103 rushing yards and added two scores. His legs were a weapon...until they weren't.

articles.title: Lions' Jahmyr Gibbs Eyes LaDainian Tomlinson TD Record as Lofty Goal for 2026 NFL Season
articles.summary: Detroit Lions star running back Jahmyr Gibbs has been a touchdown machine since he entered the NFL, and he has his eyes set on the history books.
articles.body:
Detroit Lions star running back Jahmyr Gibbs has been a touchdown machine since he entered the NFL, and he has his eyes set on the history books.

After scoring a pair of touchdowns in Sunday's 45-24 win over the Arizona Cardinals, Gibbs told reporters that he's going after Hall of Famer LaDainian Tomlinson's single-season record of 31 touchdowns.

"For sure, I'm trying to get that," Gibbs said (h/t Josh Alper of Pro Football Talk).

Gibbs now has seven rushing touchdowns and two receiving touchdowns through the first five weeks of the season. His 58 career touchdowns are the most before the age of 25 in NFL history, one more than Lions legend Barry Sanders.

Detroit has made Gibbs the focal point of its offense, as he leads the league with 132 touches. It's safe to say that he will have every opportunity to chase Tomlinson's single-season record this year.

Gibbs will continue his march toward rare air when the Lions (3-2) return to action in Week 6 against the NFC North rival Green Bay Packers (3-2).

articles.title: Maxx Crosby Foundation renews $2,000 per Raiders sack deal after Credit One Bank’s $100,000 charity push
articles.summary: The Maxx Crosby Foundation, opened by Las Vegas Raiders defensive end Maxx Crosby and his wife Rachel Crosby [nee Washburn] in 2023, supports causes
articles.body: The Maxx Crosby Foundation, opened by Las Vegas Raiders defensive end Maxx Crosby and his wife Rachel Crosby [nee Washburn] in 2023, supports causes including teen substance abuse intervention, youth health and wellness, animal rescue and abuse prevention, and other charitable initiatives.Over three years, the foundation has quickly become a means for Maxx Crosby’s off-gridiron community work.Credit One Bank turns Raiders sacks into charitable causes like Maxx Crosby FoundationThe Credit One Bank and Maxx Crosby Foundation partnership is one of the most popular defensive statistics with community-focused financial commitment. The initiative has become an annual connection between Las Vegas Raiders football and charitable causes in Southern Nevada.For Crosby, it’s a dual benefit, as the partnership acts as an opportunity to connect his gridiron duties with his everlasting commitment to the Las Vegas community.Credit One Bank started its “One For The Community” initiative in 2021. They partnered with the Maxx Crosby Foundation in 2023. For the past three years, they have collaborated on a donation model. Every Las Vegas Raiders sack during each season effectively translated into $2,000 toward charitable causes.Credit One Bank pledged $2,000 for every sack recorded by a Las Vegas Raiders player during the 2023 NFL season. The Raiders defense recorded 37 sacks, which ultimately generated $74,000. Credit One Bank increased the contribution to $100,000. One half of the amount [$50,000] went to the Maxx Crosby Foundation.Maxx Crosby Foundation benefits from Credit One Bank’s annual initiativeThen came the 2024 NFL season, and the same recipe was repeated. Only this time, there were 38 sacks, so the amount totaled $76,000. Credit One Bank again rounded up the amount to $100,000, of which one half [$50,000] went to Maxx Crosby’s foundation.In the 2025 season, the same recipe was repeated, but with only 37 sacks. Maxx Crosby personally accounted for 10 of the Raiders’ 37 sacks in 2025. However, the donation was made based on the total number of sacks, and not on Crosby’s individual stats.The total amount was $74,000. Credit One Bank rounded it up to $100,000, of which $50,000 went to the defensive end’s organization. The other co-beneficiary halves have rotated between the YMCA of Southern Nevada and Junior Achievement of Southern Nevada.Since launching in 2021, the “One For The Community” initiative has supported seven nonprofits and contributed $500,000 in total. This year, Credit One Bank announced the initiative again via Instagram in September. They will be supporting the Maxx Crosby Foundation and Junior Achievement of Southern Nevada.Junior Achievement of Southern Nevada focuses on financial literacy, career readiness, and entrepreneurial education for local students.In partnership with Junior Achievement of Southern Nevada, Credit One Bank helped 5,329 students participate in the BizTown and Finance Park programs, providing them with 95,892 cumulative contact hours of hands-on financial learning.Credit One Bank invests millions in Southern NevadaIn 2025, Credit One Bank invested $6.55 million and more than 4,400 volunteer hours into Southern Nevada, with a major focus on expanding youth financial education through partnerships with Boys & Girls Clubs of Southern Nevada and Junior Achievement of Southern Nevada.“Reflecting on the work that we have done at our organization over the last year has been truly rewarding. articles.title: 'Been A Lot of S--t Talking,' Packers Star Hyped for HC LaFleur's Win vs. Bears' Ben Johnson
articles.summary: Green Bay Packers safety Xavier McKinney took some added satisfaction from Sunday's 31-7 victory over the rival Chicago Bears.
articles.body:
Green Bay Packers safety Xavier McKinney took some added satisfaction from Sunday's 31-7 victory over the rival Chicago Bears.

McKinney told The Athletic's Michael Silver that he and his teammates wanted to deliver an emphatic performance for coach Matt LaFleur.

"There's been a lot of s--t talking, and we know how he feels about it," the veteran defensive back said.

This long-running rivalry is tilted firmly in Green Bay's favor for the last decade and change. Some wondered whether the dynamic was shifting after the Bears beat the Packers twice last year, including in the NFC Wild Card Round.

Chicago coach Ben Johnson clearly wants to lead by example, too, and display a defiance toward the Packers his players will embody.

Sunday was instead more of the same old story.

The Bears clearly missed starting quarterback Caleb Williams as Case Keenum and Tyson Bagent combined to throw for 165 yards and three interceptions. Jordan Love also did his best impression of Packers legends Brett Favre and Aaron Rodgers as he went 25-of-31 for 367 yards and two scores through the air.

The teams don't play again until Christmas Day in Week 16. That's a long time for Chicago to stew on its poor performance.

Johnson would probably be wise to dial back a little of the swagger before then as well.

articles.title: Josh Allen Compared to X-Men Supervillain Apocalypse by HOF RB as Bills QB Eyes NFL Rushing Records
articles.summary: Hall of Fame running back Curtis Martin is tied with Eric Dickerson for 14th all-time in career rushing touchdowns with 90, but he knows that Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen—who already has 86 career rushing touchdowns—will soon surpass him and a slew of other legendary halfbacks.
articles.body:
Hall of Fame running back Curtis Martin is tied with Eric Dickerson for 14th all-time in career rushing touchdowns with 90, but he knows that Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen—who already has 86 career rushing touchdowns—will soon surpass him and a slew of other legendary halfbacks.

And for Martin, that makes Allen something of a mutant.

According to Tim Graham of The Athletic, "To explain what makes Allen special, Martin searched for the name of an X-Men supervillain who possesses 'all the different superpowers combined into one, the ultimate force.' That mutant is known as Apocalypse, and he's laying waste to NFL records once dominated by running backs."

Allen, 30, already has seven rushing touchdowns through five games this season and is well on his way to recording double-digit touchdowns on the ground for a fourth straight season. It's very possible that by some point in the 2027 season he'll exceed 100 rushing touchdowns, which would put him in the top 10 all time.

At some point, Allen's physical running style may no longer be sustainable as he looks to prolong his career. But for now, seeing Allen bearing down on defenders evokes another X-Men villain—the Juggernaut.

articles.title: Chiefs Rumors Reveal New WR Contract Amid Rashee Rice, Tyquan Thornton Injuries
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs are signing wide receiver Justin Watson to their practice squad, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs are signing wide receiver Justin Watson to their practice squad, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport .

Tyquan Thornton is out for multiple months after dislocating his ankle , while Rashee Rice is nursing a hamstring injury. That created the need for Kansas City to bolster its receiver depth.

A potential reunion with eight-time Pro Bowler Tyreek Hill has been floated , but his ongoing recovery from a major knee injury could drag into November.

Watson can potentially give the team some immediate relief, and he has experience in an Andy Reid and Eric Bieniemy-led offense. He played for the Chiefs between 2022-24.

During that period, the 6'2" pass-catcher was a solid supplemental piece in the aerial attack. He had 64 receptions for 1,064 yards and seven touchdowns.

According to the Kansas City Star 's Pete Sweeney , the Chiefs weren't the only team that had Watson on their radar.

While he's only on the practice squad for now, Kansas City presumably laid out a scenario where he could be promoted to the active roster.

articles.title: Micah Parsons Injury Update, Latest Packers Star's Return Timeline Ahead of Cowboys Revenge Game
articles.summary: The Green Bay Packers "are not anticipating" star edge-rusher Micah Parsons to return to practice this week ahead of Sunday night's matchup against his former team, the Dallas Cowboys, according to ESPN's Adam Schefter.
articles.body:
The Green Bay Packers "are not anticipating" star edge-rusher Micah Parsons to return to practice this week ahead of Sunday night's matchup against his former team, the Dallas Cowboys, according to ESPN's Adam Schefter .

Per that report, "There still is uncertainty about exactly when Parsons will return from his knee injury, but the hope still remains it will be this month."

Green Bay head coach Matt LaFleur addressed the situation on Monday:

Parsons, 27, has been sidelined since December after tearing his ACL in a 34-26 loss against the Denver Broncos. It ended a strong debut season in Green Bay after Parsons recorded 12.5 sacks, 41 tackles (12 for loss), 27 quarterback hits, two forced fumbles and a pass defensed in 14 games (13 starts).

He earned Pro Bowl honors for the fifth time and was a first-team All-Pro selection for the third time.

Parsons joined Green Bay after the Dallas Cowboys traded him before the start of the 2025 season for defensive tackle Kenny Clark and first-round picks in 2026 and 2027 following a lengthy contract dispute. The Packers promptly signed him to a four-year, $188 million extension.

That made Sunday's game against the Cowboys—which would have been Parsons' second meeting against his former team following last year's wild 40-40 overtime tie in Dallas—a highly anticipated matchup. But it sounds as though Parsons isn't ready to make his return to the field just yet.

It nonetheless remains a huge game for both teams. The Cowboys are just 2-3 to start the season, while Green Bay (3-2) has won two games in a row and will be looking to continue that momentum on Sunday night.

articles.title: 49ers' Dre Greenlaw suspended 1 game after headbutting helmetless Ernest Jones IV
articles.summary: This is Greenlaw's second career suspension and his third ejection.
articles.body:
The NFL has suspended San Francisco 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw for one game after his actions in the team's Week 5 win over the Seattle Seahawks .

The league announced his suspension on Monday. Greenlaw intends to appeal the decision, NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports .

According to the league's press release, Greenlaw "used his helmet to headbutt Seattle linebacker Ernest Jones IV, who was not wearing a helmet, violating Rule 12, Section 3, Article 1, which applies to "any act which is contrary to the generally understood principles of sportsmanship.'"

Greenlaw was flagged for hitting Sam Darnold late when the quarterback was running out of bounds. It happened on the Seattle sideline, so the Seahawks came to their quarterback's aid.

Jones confronted Greenlaw and appeared to push the 49ers linebacker's facemask.

Greenlaw responded by headbutting Jones, who was not wearing a helmet.

Replay caught the action, and it was reviewed. According to the postgame pool report , the league used its new rule, under which the Art McNally Gameday Central in New York can eject a player even without a flag being thrown. This stemmed, in part, from DK Metcalf's interaction with a fan last year.

The review cited Greenlaw for non-football conduct, and he was ejected for the rest of the game.

If the linebacker doesn't appeal, he'll serve a one-game suspension for San Francisco's Week 6 matchup with the Washington Commanders on Monday night.

This isn't Greenlaw's first ejection. He first got the boot after a helmet-to-helmet hit on Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert. Greenlaw then made headlines after Philadelphia Eagles chief of security Big Dom confronted him, and the linebacker shoved his face before getting ejected.

Greenlaw was suspended for one game in 2025 after he confronted and "verbally threatened" referee Brad Allen following a loss. The linebacker was fined for taunting earlier this season after repeatedly exchanging words with the Denver Broncos' sideline and head coach Sean Payton after Denver released him earlier this year.

articles.title: 49ers' Dre Greenlaw Suspended by NFL After Being Ejected for Headbutting Seahawks' Ernest Jones IV
articles.summary: The NFL announced Monday it suspended San Francisco 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw for one game for headbutting Seattle Seahawks linebacker Ernest Jones IV.
articles.body:
The NFL announced Monday it suspended San Francisco 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw for one game for headbutting Seattle Seahawks linebacker Ernest Jones IV.

The league cited Rule 12, Section 3, Article 1 to say the incident qualified as an unsportsmanlike act.

Greenlaw will appeal the punishment, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport . Derrick Brooks, Jordy Nelson, Ron Rivera or James Thrash will oversee the appeal based on the terms of the collective bargaining agreement.

The Niners veteran was ejected in the second quarter of Sunday's 32-29 win over the Seahawks. He found himself on Seattle's sideline after giving a late shove out of bounds to Seattle quarterback Sam Darnold.

Jones, who didn't have his helmet on, and Greenlaw briefly exchanged words before Greenlaw thrust his head forward:

The Seahawks scored 13 unanswered points in the third quarter but cooled off when it counted. San Francisco briefly took the lead when Brock Purdy hit Brandin Cooks for a seven-yard touchdown pass in the fourth. After a 40-yard field goal from Jason Myers tied the game, Eddy Pineiro provided the decisive score with a 44-yarder.

Niners coach Kyle Shanahan will now have a week to prepare for the potential that Garret Wallow or another linebacker is starting in Greenlaw's place.

San Francisco faces off with the Washington Commanders in Week 6.

The matchup got a little trickier with Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels returning from a dislocated elbow for Sunday's 27-27 tie with the New York Giants. He threw for 199 yards and was the game's leading rusher (103 yards) while scoring twice on the ground.

articles.title: Micah Parsons reportedly not expected to return from ACL tear for Packers-Cowboys game Sunday night
articles.summary: Sunday night's clash against his former Cowboys had been circled as a potential return date for Parsons from his torn ACL.
articles.body:
Micah Parsons won't return to football this week to face his former Dallas Cowboys.

That's per ESPN's Adam Schefter, who reported Monday that the Green Bay Packers don't expect their All-Pro pass rusher to practice this week ahead of Sunday night's game against Dallas.

Parsons has been sidelined since sustaining a torn ACL in Week 15 last season. He said in August that it was "very realistic" that he could return by Week 6 to play the Cowboys, confirming reports that the Dallas game was a potential target date.

Now, that's reportedly off the table. Per Schefter, uncertainty remains regarding when he returns, but there's hope that Parsons could make his 2026 debut sometime in October.

Parsons suffered his injury 14 games into his tenure with the Packers after arriving via a blockbuster trade from the Cowboys. He had surgery to repair the torn ACL and meniscus in his left knee.

A three-time All-Pro and four-time Pro Bowler in four seasons with the Cowboys, Parsons maintained his elite form in Green Bay prior to his injury, tallying 12.5 sacks, 27 quarterback hits and 12 tackles for loss in 14 games. He was named first-team All-Pro despite missing Green Bay's final three games.

When healthy, Parsons is the anchor of Green Bay's defense and a significant part of the team's hopes to compete for the NFC North and a Super Bowl. Those hopes were dampened by a 1-2 start that featured poor offensive play. Green Bay has since won two straight games, including a 31-7 blowout of the rival Chicago Bears on Sunday to improve to 3-2 and remain on track to compete for a playoff spot.

Parsons' return this week would have bolstered Green Bay's playoff prospects. But, as of Monday, it remains unclear when Parsons will play again.

articles.title: Is Madison Beer Justin Herbert’s downfall? Fans slam her for skipping Chargers game to hang out with friends
articles.summary: Well, Chargers fans are not holding back!
articles.body: Well, Chargers fans are not holding back! Justin Herbert’s fiancée Madison Beer is finding herself caught in the middle of an online debate after reportedly being spotted out and about in Los Angeles, hanging out with friends and grabbing lunch while the Chargers quarterback was taking the field. And, naturally, the internet has opinions.Madison Beer spotted chilling with friends as Justin Herbert takes the fieldBeer, who is engaged to the Los Angeles Chargers superstar, has found herself under the spotlight after reports of her outing began circulating on social media. While grabbing lunch with friends sounds like a pretty normal day out, some football fans apparently aren't seeing it that way, especially when Herbert is the one making headlines on game day.Forget the usual game-day drama for a second, because Madison's reported plans outside the stadium have become a talking point of their own.The singer and model was reportedly spotted walking around Los Angeles and enjoying lunch with friends instead of being in the stands cheering on her fiancé. And while there's absolutely nothing unusual about spending time with friends, some fans seem to believe that supporting your partner on game day should be part of the deal.For some Chargers supporters, seeing Beer out enjoying her day while Herbert was busy with football has apparently raised eyebrows. Others, however, may argue that she has her own schedule, career and personal life, and shouldn't be expected to attend every game. After all, being engaged to an NFL quarterback doesn't automatically mean someone has to spend every Sunday inside a football stadium.And while Madison Beer’s reported lunch outing has become a talking point online, Justin Herbert has a much bigger problem to deal with on the football field. The Chargers quarterback suffered another frustrating defeat on Sunday, as Los Angeles fell 23–17 to the Denver Broncos to drop to 0–5 for the first time since 2003.Herbert completed just 14 of 24 passes for 121 yards, throwing one touchdown and one interception. But it was his fourth-quarter mistakes that really hurt. After the Chargers took a 17–10 lead, Herbert was stopped on a fourth-and-one attempt, fumbled the ball on the next possession and threw an interception on the drive that followed. Denver turned those opportunities into points and walked away with the win.The quarterback has now thrown seven interceptions against five touchdown passes through five games, adding to the frustration surrounding the Chargers' winless start.However, Herbert isn't shouldering all the blame alone.
